articles.company_name: Platinum Group Metals Ltd. Ordinary Shares (Canada)
articles.summary: Platinum Group Metals (NYSE: PLG) has announced a non-brokered private placement to raise US$1,008,000 through the sale of 800,000 common shares at US$1.26 per share to Hosken Consolidated Investments Limited (HCI). The offering price represents a 3.1% premium to the company's 5-day VWAP on NYSE American as of May 9, 2025. The proceeds will fund pre-construction work, engineering, and preparation costs at the Waterberg Project in South Africa, along with general corporate purposes. This placement will restore HCI's ownership stake to 26% in the company. The shares will be subject to a four-month plus one-day trading restriction period following the closing.
articles.title: Platinum Group Metals Ltd. Announces Non-Brokered Private Placement
